description: Create a new scene file with a single root node, written to scenePath. Use to start a scene from scratch; to add nodes to an existing scene use add_node. rootNodeType defaults to Node2D: pass "Node3D" for 3D or "Control" for UI. Saves automatically and overwrites an existing file silently. Returns: the scenePath that was written. Errors while a runtime session is live on this project.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project (e.g. "scenes/main.tscn")

name: create_scene

scenePath.description: Project-relative path of the scene file that was written.
